title: Semaine sanglante
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Semaine sanglante", at revision 1382683028, opens: "The semaine sanglante was a weeklong battle in Paris from 21 to 28 May 1871, during which the French Army recaptured the city from the Communards. This was the final battle of the Paris Commune." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3478362, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1871 weeklong siege of Paris by the Versailles government to recapture it from the Paris Commune". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
